releasePlan.notes: Flag enable-player-login already existed (created dark in an earlier run tagged pr-34; v1 unreleased, off in production+test). PR #35 code lives under v1. Flag is evaluated once in init() after LD init and before identify(). Control = original start screen. Known v1 caveat: the R key / touch restart button can bypass the login (restartGame hides loginOverlay). RANDOMIZATION UNIT = ld_device (rework 2): every visitor shares the user key 'anonymous-player', so the user kind cannot split traffic. invaders.html now adds a stable per-browser anonymous 'ld_device' context (localStorage 'galactic-defender-ld-device', crypto.randomUUID) ALONGSIDE the unchanged user context as a multi-context, at initialize() AND in the v1 callsign identify(). The user part is byte-identical, so invaders-shooter-sprite targeting is unaffected. Because ld_device survives identify(), post-login v1 events (returning players, gameplay errors) stay attributed. ld_device is already an experiment-enabled randomization unit in project 'default'. The guarded rollout MUST randomize by ld_device. METRICS (track()-backed; no observability/OTel stack in this page; all created fresh on ld_device with known event keys): enable-player-login-device-error-rate = KILLSWITCH (event enable-player-login-error: uncaught errors + unhandled rejections, both variations); enable-player-login-device-latency = MONITORING (event enable-player-login-time-to-entry, ms from page start to first-screen exit; v1 is slower by design, so it must not gate); enable-player-login-device-entry-rate = MONITORING (event enable-player-login-entry, first-screen exit, both variations). The earlier user-unit keys (enable-player-login-error-rate / -latency / -entry-rate) were removed from this plan: they cannot be analyzed in an ld_device rollout, and two of them had unverifiable pre-existing definitions.
